sub_answers.text: Electoral system reforms ahead of the 2026 Senedd election — increasing the Senedd from 60 to 96 members, adopting party-list proportional representation, reducing constituencies and shortening terms — changed the electoral landscape in ways that undermined Labour's historical dominance [d68245236s0p0]. sub_answers.text: Welsh Labour's 2021 Senedd manifesto emphasised health and social care improvements, including investment in mental health services and moves toward free-at-point-of-use social care as part of a UK-wide reform [d33580665s8p0].
